scope: Retrospective date-causal course-distribution method only; no Prediction integration or full historical vintage as-of certification

method.name: NATIONAL_BOAT_NO_ACTUAL_COURSE_FREQUENCY
method.geographic_scope: national except Edogawa; no venue-specific model

dataset.source: existing Canonical core.race, core.race_entry, core.race_result and core.race_result_state

window.start_inclusive: previous calendar year's same month and day; Feb 29 maps to Feb 28
window.formula: start = D.replace(year=D.year-1); if invalid because D is Feb 29, start = Feb 28 of D.year-1; include start <= race_date < D

time_boundary.daily_state: all D races use the same frozen D-1 counts and probabilities
time_boundary.update: only after every D race has been predicted/scored; D results first available to this method on D+1

race_requirements: six race entries with boat_no exactly 1..6
six canonical result rows, one for each boat_no
six actual_course values form exactly the permutation 1..6
at least one canonical finish_position is non-NULL
eligibility.special_finish: allowed when all course-specific requirements hold
eligibility.duplicate_or_incomplete_finish_rank: does not by itself exclude a race if at least one numeric finish exists; Rating STRICT is separate

probability.counts: N[b,k] = count of eligible non-Edogawa races in the window with boat_no=b and actual_course=k
probability.normal_case: six values each in [0,1] and sum exactly 1 within floating tolerance
probability.zero_course_cell: P(k|b)=0 when N[b,k]=0 and the boat-number total is positive

zero_history.production_2026_zero_history_check: UNKNOWN; checking it requires 2025 results, excluded from this freeze

development_evidence.selection: RECENT_1Y has the lowest 2023 and 2024 log loss among the evaluated windows; RECENT_2Y is runner-up
development_evidence.zero_cell_evaluator_guard: The development evaluator raises on a zero individual course cell; no evaluated cell was zero (minimum 5). The formal positive-total zero-cell rule above is explicitly fixed here and was not empirically exercised.

as_of_limitation: Date-causal D-1 OOS is verified. Current Canonical data do not prove which historical correction vintage was published by every D; full vintage as-of evaluation remains unverified and is required separately for strict historical Prediction simulation.
rating_boundary: Rating v1 and its frozen venue-by-boat Dirichlet prediction-course diagnostic remain unchanged. This independent national un-smoothed layer does not retroactively alter Rating v1; later Prediction integration must resolve the interface explicitly.

holdout_2025.future_rule: Any 2025 check occurs only after this method freeze; do not retune v1 and then call the same 2025 outcomes independent.

revision_rule: After 2025 outcomes are inspected, any method/window/eligibility change must be a new version and cannot reuse 2025 as an independent holdout.
